steps.title: Gather Materials
steps.instruction: You need an eight-and-a-half by 11 inch sheet of paper.

steps.title: Fold in Half
steps.instruction: Fold the paper in half lengthwise.

steps.title: Open and Fold Top
steps.instruction: Open the paper and fold the top down, leaving just a little more than an inch at the bottom.
steps.additional_guidance: Needs visual review: clarify 'a little more than an inch'.

steps.title: Fold Back
steps.instruction: Open that back up and fold down the line you just made.

steps.title: Fold to Center
steps.instruction: Fold the game now fold to the center to make triangles.

steps.title: Tuck Layers
steps.instruction: Tuck these layers into the central pocket.

steps.title: Fold in Half Again
steps.instruction: Lay your model flat like so and fold it in half on that center crease.

steps.title: Fold Wing
steps.instruction: Now just fold the wing like so.

steps.title: Throw Airplane
steps.instruction: And there you go open it up and give that thing a throw.
